description.value: Little Sprout Café is a social enterprise café operated by Communitas Supportive Care Society, a BC charity supporting people living with disabilities, with all profits reinvested into that mission. The menu centres on microgreens grown in-house and Fraser Valley sourced ingredients, prepared in a fully visible open-kitchen concept by an inclusively hired team. It is a community-rooted, values-driven spot that offers a genuinely local and nutritious food stop in the Abbotsford area.

address.value: 102 – 2776 Bourquin Crescent West, Abbotsford, BC V2S 6A4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and detailed. The café is confirmed open with a full address matching the OSM street/unit/postal data (102-2776 Bourquin Crescent West, V2S 6A4), though the OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' while the website consistently says 'Abbotsford' — the V2S postal code is an Abbotsford code, so the OSM community tag appears incorrect. Takeout/pickup is explicitly and prominently promoted on the website; the microgreens page describes 'plant-forward recipes' as positive evidence for vegetarian options. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the website consistently identifies the location as Abbotsford, BC; postal code V2S 6A4 is an Abbotsford code, indicating the OSM community assignment is incorrect.
OSM record has no phone number; website provides 604.504.0248.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Sa 07:30-14:30) differ slightly from website-stated hours (Mon-Sat 8:00am–3:00pm); website hours appear more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating café with a live website, confirmed address, and clear business identity. Straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Microgreens page states 'Locally sourced ingredients and plant-forward recipes are part of how we express our values'; menu is built around in-house-grown microgreens and fresh plant-based ingredients

wow_evidence: social enterprise café operated by Communitas Supportive Care Society, a BC charity supporting people living with disabilities
